title: Commodity cross-section: lottery (MAX) and idiosyncratic volatility (Fuertes, Miffre and Fernandez-Perez 2015)
universe: GC SI HG CL NG RB HO ZC ZS ZW LE HE, monthly rebalance at month end (Gen143 xs helper: inverse-vol, dollar-balanced legs)

families.MX: score = max daily return over the past 21 days; long the n lowest, short the n highest; n {3, 4}
families.IV: score = sd of residuals from regressing daily returns on the equal-weighted commodity average over the past 63 days; long the n lowest, short the n highest; n {3, 4}

selection: best on 2010-06..2022-12 per family; enters only if > 0.3
judgement: current 15-sleeve book + entrants; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 1.137
